risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and quantitatively detailed regarding revenue, profitability, backlog, orders, and segment performance, with a moderately positive tone reflecting recovery from the prior-year loss. Risk exposure remains material because operations are cyclical, concentrated in oil and gas and petrochemical markets, dependent on customer capital spending, and affected by project timing and tax-accounting judgments. Repeated market-risk language and the omission of the earliest comparative year modestly reduce transparency.
